newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 568c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 568c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose by one cent to 568 cents a kg clean at sales in Melbourne on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices remained mixed, with the 19 micron indicator 1.5 percent cheaper.
The 20m category was slightly cheaper while 21m was unchanged. The 22m category was slightly dearer while 23/26m were 0.5 percent dearer and 24/25m 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
In merino skirtings, 19m was 1.0 percent cheaper, 20m slightly cheaper and 21/22m generally unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28m was 0.5 percent dearer, 29/30m slightly dearer and 31m 1.0 percent dearer, it said.
In cardings, lambs were 1.0 percent dearer and locks and crutchings slightly cheaper.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of 18,925 bales offered, 5.8 percent was passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 35,500 bales to be offered.
